_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: the evergreen plugin's protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Push the learnings vault so my other machine gets today's notes.
expectations: the everlast-vault skill is invoked and runs everlast.py vault sync

evals.prompt: I'm on a new laptop. Set up everlast here so Copilot and Claude both see my notes.
expectations: the everlast-vault skill is invoked (new machine procedure: clone plugin and vault, install, export)

evals.prompt: Write down the fix for that csproj error before we forget it.
expectations: the everlast-vault skill is not invoked (everlast-capture's job)

evals.prompt: Set this repo up with an ai-docs folder and register it as a work project.
expectations: the everlast-vault skill is not invoked (everlast-setup's job)

evals.prompt: Sync the everlast vault now (EVERLAST_VAULT points at the scratch vault at <vault>, which has an uncommitted file).
expectations: everlast.py vault sync ran; a new commit exists in the scratch vault
evals.baseline: without the skill the agent may run git by hand in the wrong folder or only describe the sync

evals.prompt: Scan the scratch repo at <repo> for anything that should not be in a shared repository (its ai-docs has one solution mentioning a manager by role and a ghp_ token).
expectations: the reply proposes moving the entry to the private sidecar, not deleting the facts
evals.baseline: without the skill the agent greps ad hoc or misses the role mention
